# Pinned native WikiPathways GMT reader

These two unmodified MIT-licensed author files are from
[`wikipathways/pywikipathways`](https://github.com/wikipathways/pywikipathways)
at commit `2e77a5665f8261b56e2ef61d8b0106c220193ac5`:

- `pywikipathways/read_gmt.py`
- `pywikipathways/read_pathway_gmt.py`

Their filenames here match the reviewed source-packet convention. The license
is preserved in `LICENSE`. The optional scientific integration test executes
the actual functions on an invented GMT fixture, with their original source
hashes checked by `wiki_current_view.author_memberships`. No native biological
data or full third-party package is bundled here.
